{{Quote|Blades are flying cannons, they have low-powered deflectors. One hit is all it takes.''"<br />"''TIE fighters, Sith designs are the same no matter the time.|[[Relin Druur]] and [[Khedryn Faal]] pursued by Blades|<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Blade''-class starfighter''' was a crescent shaped [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the years of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. It was used to protect mining ships such as the ''[[Omen]]'' and the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. They were very fast and maneuverable, though they lacked [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], very similar to the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nearly five thousand years later. They were also piloted by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilots, possibly even [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
